results.summary: This project is an 8-bit arithmetic logic unit (ALU) that performs arithmetic and bitwise operations on integer binary numbers. It uses a state machine to read two operands from the input pins and control the operation. The result and status flags are output on the bidirectional and output pins. It is implemented in Verilog and is intended for educational use.
